dedupe_keys.name: 3difice a synthetic dataset for training computer vision algorithms to recognize earthquake damage to reinforced concrete structures

description: 3DIFICE: A Synthetic Dataset for Training Computer Vision Algorithms to Recognize Earthquake Damage to Reinforced Concrete Structures is a data set deposited in Illinois Data Bank by its authors Nathaniel Levine. 3DIFICE: 3-dimensional Damage Imposed on Frame structures for Investigating Computer vision-based Evaluation methods This dataset contains 1,396 synthetic images and label maps with various types of earthquake damage imposed on reinforced concrete frame structures. Damage includes: cracking, spalling, exposed transverse rebar, and exposed longitudinal rebar. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
